beats.caption: A user wants to sign in.
beats.say: A user opens the app and clicks Sign in.

beats.caption: The app hands off to the identity provider.
beats.say: The app never sees the password. It sends the browser to an identity provider instead.

beats.caption: The user signs in with the provider.
beats.say: The user signs in there, and agrees to share their photos with the app.

actions.title: One password
actions.text: The user signs in with an account they already have.

beats.caption: The provider sends back a one-time code.
beats.say: The provider redirects back with a short-lived, one-time code.

beats.caption: The browser passes the code to the app.
beats.say: The browser hands that code to the app.

beats.caption: The app swaps the code for a token.
beats.say: Now the app talks to the provider directly, server to server, and swaps the code for a token.

actions.title: Back channel
actions.text: The client secret never reaches the browser.

beats.caption: The provider returns an access token.
beats.say: The provider checks the code and the secret, and returns an access token.

beats.caption: The app starts a session.
beats.say: The app saves a session, so the user stays signed in.

beats.caption: The token unlocks the user's photos.
beats.say: With the token, the app can fetch the user's photos, and nothing else.

beats.caption: Signed in, without sharing a password.
beats.say: The user is in, and their password never touched the app.
